reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling through distributors and contractors into commercial construction. Carlisle's products are roofing, waterproofing and insulation, which SPX does not make. SPX's core is HVAC equipment (cooling towers, boilers, electric heat) plus detection and measurement systems sold to utilities and transit agencies. The only product overlap is Carlisle's small HVAC brands line. Customer overlap is partial: contractors, building owners and distributors. Carlisle sells roofing contractors and SPX sells HVAC engineers and contractors, and SPX also sells to utilities and governments. This is overlap in some customers and a little in product, not both fully, so the grade is 1.
